hooks.text: 武器、护甲和装备随机生成属性与词缀，普通装备也能围绕特定协同构成核心构筑。
hooks.excerpt: Weapons, armor, and equipment roll with randomized attributes and affixes, allowing even ordinary gear to become something powerful in the right build.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: Cartifact 魔法卡会从根本上改变构筑，并可组合出中毒近战接对中毒目标暴击等连锁。
hooks.excerpt: Cartifacts are mysterious magical cards that can be equipped to fundamentally change how your build functions. Each Cartifact grants unique combat effects that can synergize with one another in powerful ways, opening the door for countless strategies and combinations. Why not equip one Cartifact that causes melee attacks to poison enemies, then combine it with another that increases critical strike chance against poisoned targets?
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 避难所是永久成长核心，可建设庇护所、工坊、农场、仓库和防御设施以解锁 NPC 与新制作选项。
hooks.excerpt: Your base is more than just decoration. It is a core part of progression. Gather resources to build shelters, crafting stations, farms, storage, defenses, and homes for wandering survivors. As your settlement grows, new crafting options, beneficial NPCs, sustainable food production, and progression opportunities become available.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
